segments.name: Environmentally sustainable specialty chemicals
segments.description: Develops and sells environmentally sustainable fire inhibitor chemicals and proactive wildfire defense systems for lumber, wood products, wildland fire and residential home protection markets.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, we determined we operate in a single reporting segment - environmentally sustainable specialty chemicals for fire prevention and protection in the lumber and wood products, wildland fire and residential home industry.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by lumber and wood product companies, home, industrial and commercial users, and fire departments that purchase its CitroTech fire inhibitor products and defense systems.
revenueModel.evidence: CitroTech markets its product primarily to lumber and wood product companies, home, industrial and commercial users, as well as fire departments.
